description: Save/resume: Save/resume pairing, part 1 of 2 (see resume_after_save.json). Sign in as the last player, dismiss the two new-user tutorials, walk right a little, then Esc -> 'y' confirms the 'Exit and Save' dialog (dialog_run kind=7), which calls slot_table_save() and longjmp(game_abort_jmpbuf, 3) -- game_run() sees d==3 and returns, so the process exits cleanly (exit code 0) after writing AE000_0NN.rec save files. To verify resume, run this manifest's script against a chosen --saves DIR, then separately launch empires.exe again with --saves DIR (same dir) and the script in resume_after_save.json, and confirm it lands back at the START of Near East chamber 0 (campaign_chapter_advance() resumes at round/node granularity via slot_table[].resume_round + round_progress[], not mid-chamber position -- this is the correct historical behaviour per src/GAME.C's game_run/campaign_chapter_advance, not a bug). NOTE: tools/portable/replay_test.py always runs each manifest in its own fresh tempfile.mkdtemp() --saves dir, so it cannot exercise this two-process resume chain automatically; run both scripts by hand with an explicit shared --saves dir instead. THEN Save/resume pairing, part 2 of 2 (see save_quit_mid_level.json). Run save_quit_mid_level.json's script first against a chosen --saves DIR (produces AE000_0NN.rec with slot_table[].resume_round set), then run THIS script against the SAME --saves DIR. Sign-in ('slot_menu_run' -> up arrow -> Enter, same as always) is followed directly by '@level_driver_run' with NO '@player_select_run' wait: game_run() takes the resume_round branch (src/GAME.C:733) and calls campaign_chapter_advance() directly, skipping player_select_run() entirely and skipping the two new-user tutorial dialogs (the resumed player is no longer 'new'). If a script for a resumed player still waits on '@player_select_run' (a mistake made once during this QA pass) the marker never fires and the whole script silently stalls -- s_script_next parked on that marker entry forever, no key past it is ever injected, and the run just idles out at --selftest-ms with no error printed. Confirmed: relaunch lands back at Near East chamber 0's start (x=24, empty-handed) with the HUD's low-energy 'New User Message' dialog (energy carried over from the previous session via slot_table[current_slot].state) -- no crash.
